TechVision Conference 2024

Discover the future of technology with industry leaders, cutting-edge insights, and hands-on sessions. Join us in San Francisco this June.

Get Tickets Now Meet Our Speakers

📅 June 15–17, 2024

Three days of immersive tech talks, workshops, and networking opportunities designed for innovators, developers, and tech leaders.

📍 San Francisco, CA

Join us at the iconic San Francisco Convention Center, strategically located in the heart of the tech industry.

🎯 250+ Speakers & 50+ Sessions

Learn from the brightest minds in AI, cloud computing, cybersecurity, and digital transformation.

Why Attend TechVision 2024?

Network with Industry Leaders

Connect with CEOs, CTOs, and innovators from Fortune 500 companies and groundbreaking startups. Build meaningful relationships that drive your career forward.

Learn Emerging Technologies

Explore the latest trends in artificial intelligence, machine learning, blockchain, and quantum computing through expert-led sessions and live demonstrations.

Gain Practical Skills

Participate in hands-on workshops and labs where you can develop real-world solutions and earn industry-recognized certifications.

Discover Innovation

Visit the Innovation Expo to see cutting-edge products, prototypes, and services from leading tech companies and promising startups.

Featured Speakers

Dr. Sarah Chen

Chief AI Researcher

TechCore Labs

Leading expert in artificial intelligence and machine learning with 15+ years of experience. Dr. Chen will discuss the future of AI ethics and responsible innovation.

Marcus Johnson

VP of Cloud Infrastructure

CloudScale Inc.

Industry pioneer in cloud-native architecture and microservices. Marcus will share strategies for scaling systems to billions of users.

Lisa Rodriguez

Founder & CEO

SecureShield Technologies

Conference Speakers

Meet the industry experts and thought leaders who will be sharing their insights at TechVision Conference 2024. Our speakers bring decades of combined experience in artificial intelligence, cloud computing, cybersecurity, and digital transformation.

Dr. Sarah Chen

Chief AI Officer

InnovateTech Solutions

Dr. Chen leads AI strategy and machine learning initiatives. She holds a PhD in Computer Science and has published over 50 papers on neural networks and deep learning applications in enterprise systems.

With 15 years in the AI industry, Dr. Sarah Chen has transformed how enterprises approach machine learning. Her work at InnovateTech has resulted in three successful product launches and partnerships with Fortune 500 companies. She is a regular speaker at international conferences and serves on the advisory board of the Global AI Ethics Initiative.

Marcus Rodriguez

VP of Cloud Infrastructure

CloudFirst Corp

Marcus oversees cloud operations for a portfolio of enterprise clients managing over 10 million workloads. He specializes in hybrid cloud architecture, cost optimization, and infrastructure automation.

Marcus brings 18 years of experience in cloud architecture and DevOps. Before joining CloudFirst, he spent a decade at a major hyperscaler, where he contributed to foundational cloud infrastructure projects. He is a certified architect for all major cloud platforms and has helped organizations save millions in cloud spending through strategic optimization.

Elena Volkova

Director of Cybersecurity

SecureNet

Elena leads threat intelligence and incident response teams. She has responded to over 500 security incidents and specializes in zero-trust architecture, ransomware prevention, and compliance frameworks.

With 20 years in cybersecurity, Elena is recognized as a leading expert in breach response and prevention. She has published guidelines adopted by NIST and regularly advises governments on critical infrastructure protection. Her research on emerging threats has been cited in over 200 industry reports.

James Wu

Chief Technology Officer

DataFlow Systems

James drives innovation in big data analytics and real-time processing systems. He leads a team of 150 engineers and has built systems processing petabytes of data daily for global enterprises.

James has 16 years of experience in distributed systems and data engineering. He has contributed to open-source projects including Apache Kafka and Apache Spark. His expertise spans real-time analytics, data pipelines, and scalable architecture design. He holds multiple patents in data processing technologies.

Priya Kapoor

Head of Product

FutureApps Inc

Priya leads product strategy for an emerging fintech platform serving 2 million users. She combines technical expertise with product thinking to deliver user-centric solutions in highly regulated environments.

With 14 years in product development and technology, Priya has launched 12 successful products across SaaS and fintech sectors. She is an expert in navigating regulatory compliance while maintaining rapid innovation. Priya is also an active mentor for women in tech and has advised over 50 startups on product strategy.

David Chen

Senior DevOps Engineer

EngineerFirst

David specializes in infrastructure-as-code, container orchestration, and CI/CD pipeline optimization. He has deployed and managed Kubernetes clusters for applications serving millions of concurrent users.

David brings 12 years of experience in systems engineering and DevOps practices. He is a Kubernetes expert and has contributed to several CNCF projects. His focus on automation and reliability has reduced deployment times by 80% for his clients. He regularly speaks at tech conferences about container best practices.

Premium experience

$599 best value

Exclusive VIP experience with premium access, reserved seating, and special events.

  • Access to all 3 days of sessions
  • Reserved seating in main auditorium
  • VIP welcome reception
  • Premium meals (all 3 days)
  • One-on-one speaker meet & greet
  • Exclusive VIP lounge access
  • Premium conference materials
  • VIP badge and gift bag

What's Included?

  • All Ticket Tiers: Full access to keynote sessions, technical workshops, and panel discussions
  • Networking: Connect with industry leaders, innovators, and fellow attendees
  • Materials: Access to slide decks and resources from all sessions
  • Digital Access: Post-conference video recordings available for 90 days

Important Information

  • Refund Policy: Full refunds available up to June 1, 2024. After that date, no refunds but transfers allowed.
  • Group Discounts: 10% discount available for groups of 5 or more. Contact sales@techvisionconf.com
  • Student Rates: 50% off for full-time students with valid ID
  • Accessibility: All venues are wheelchair accessible. Request accommodations during checkout.

Frequently Asked Questions

Can I change my ticket tier after purchase?

Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade your ticket up to June 1, 2024. Please contact support@techvisionconf.com with your order confirmation to request a change. Any price difference will be applied to your account.

Is accommodation included with my ticket?

Conference tickets do not include hotel accommodation. However, we have negotiated special rates at partner hotels including the San Francisco Grand (20% discount), Tech Tower Hotel (15% discount), and Innovation Inn (10% discount). Visit our website for hotel booking links and discount codes.

Can I transfer my ticket to someone else?

Yes, you can transfer your ticket to another person up to 48 hours before the conference starts. Email support@techvisionconf.com with your order number and the attendee's name and email address. They'll receive a new ticket confirmation.

Do you offer single-day tickets?

Single-day tickets are available for $129 (Early Bird) or $199 (Standard) and include access to all sessions on your chosen day, lunch, and conference materials. Contact sales@techvisionconf.com to purchase single-day passes.

What payment methods do you accept?

We accept all major credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express), PayPal, and bank transfers. All transactions are processed securely via Stripe. Invoicing is available for corporate purchases over $2,000.

When will I receive my ticket confirmation?

You'll receive an email confirmation immediately after purchase with your ticket details, attendee badge, and instructions for checking in at the venue. Physical badges and materials will be available at registration on June 15, 2024.

After May 31, tickets will be available at standard pricing ($349 for Standard tier).
